description:
A superb opportunity to acquire a substantial five-bedroom detached home in the highly sought-after and prestigious Ard Na Mara development in Malahide.

Number 141 offers generous accommodation throughout, with excellent potential for a new owner to enhance and modernise the property to create a wonderful family home. The property has been extended to the rear and also benefits from an attic extension, currently used as a bedroom, with a bathroom located on this level.

The accommodation is complemented by a very large rear garden, offering excellent outdoor space and considerable scope for further enhancement, subject to the necessary planning permissions. The west-facing living accommodation enjoys an abundance of natural light throughout the day. The property was insulated and pumped-wrapped in 2011.

The location is a particular highlight. Ard Na Mara is an established and prestigious residential setting within Malahide, with a shop conveniently located directly across the road. Malahide Village is approximately a 10-minute walk, offering an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, boutiques and everyday amenities. Malahide Castle and its beautiful grounds, the coast and a host of recreational amenities are also close by.

There are a number of local schools in the surrounding area, while bus stops are just a few minutes' walk from the property, providing convenient transport links.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial detached home in one of Malahide's most established and desirable locations, with excellent potential to enhance and tailor the accommodation to suit individual requirements.

Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant: Having been vacant for over two years, this property qualifies for consideration under the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant scheme, subject to the scheme’s terms and conditions.

Viewing is highly recommended.
